mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For supported postdoctoral fellows | HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.mapping_description: The concept describes an international (Hungary→Bulgaria) and inter-sectoral (academic MATE/MVCRI plus non-academic AgroVIR farmer-field) research programme across agronomy, remote sensing, machine learning and plant physiology, which logically develops the fellow's research and transferable skills. Inference chain: the concept describes a cross-country, inter-sectoral, interdisciplinary research action which leads to acquisition of new research and transferable competences which satisfies outcome EO-01. However, 'employability', 'career prospects' and an explicit skills-acquisition plan are not stated in the concept.

mappings.tier2b_source_ref: Expected Outcome — For supported postdoctoral fellows | HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json
mappings.mapping_description: The concept explicitly builds an international, inter-sectoral, interdisciplinary experience through the MATE (Hungary) → MVCRI (Bulgaria) → AgroVIR (non-academic farmer-field) validation ladder. Inference chain: the concept describes cross-country and academic/non-academic collaboration across multiple disciplines which leads to new mind-sets and approaches to R&I work which satisfies outcome EO-02. The MSCA career-development vocabulary ('mind-sets', 'R&I work') is not used verbatim, so the mapping is inferred rather than confirmed.
